additional_info.subject: ID0415952-DC/Si-D/GR - [MP / R6 170002080] ErrorCode: "SafetyRelay_QA26" CRM:02698000016
additional_info.body:
Hi Olympia,
Unfortunately yes, this error is still persisting. I would recommend checking 2 things, if the XD7.1A and 7.1B are properly fitted which are these, right above the EcoGs:
You can just plug out and plug in. Also check if any of the cables are loose from the connector itself and not the connector.
Next step would be to check if FC20 is tripped, it's probbaly tripped since the error is really about that, the Fan doesn't get 230V because it's tripped.
After rearming the FC20 and plugging in and out the XD7.1A/B check if it's working again. If it's not working then there might be a short circuit in that line. Please check on the roof if there is any damaged cable going to the Fan from the XD7.1, if yes, I assume we need to replace the whole fan since there is no way to replace the cables.
I hope I answered to your needs :)
Have a nice weekend!
Best regards,
Francisco
